messages:
Jonah: Quick heads up — staging shows a 9–12x token-cost spike from embeddings-service after the model pin for tomorrow's change window. Not an accuracy regression, but unit-costs and CPU memory climb. Requesting a freeze-exemption to rollback the model pin to v2.12 ASAP.

Maya: Can you paste the metrics? is this reproducible on a small load?

Jonah: Repro steps are consistent. Short snippet from staging metrics:
```
service: embeddings
model: redwood-embed-v2.14
median_latency: 46ms
cpu_rss: 78% -> 92% after 100k reqs
cost_per_1k: $0.85 -> $7.40
```

Deploy Bot: Automated check: next scheduled change window starts 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Rollouts during freeze require explicit exemption and two approvals.

Natalie: If we rollback to v2.12, do clients need any change? Is there version pinning to update?

Jonah: No client changes. It's a server-side model pin — config is in runtime model-catalog. Rolling back is just updating the pin + small KV cache bust.

Paul: What's the rollback plan? Can we canary in us-west2 first to observe cost impact?

Jonah: Proposed plan: 1) Canary 5% traffic to v2.12 in us-west2 for 15m; 2) monitor token cost & cpu; 3) if stable, ramp to 100% in 10m; 4) update change log + release notes. Command to run canary:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/embeddings embeddings=model:v2.12 --record
# or use deploy-bot: /deploy canary embeddings v2.12 --region us-west2 --percent 5 --duration 15m
```

Maya: ok please create a short runbook entry in the ticket and include the rollback command. I approve the exemption for this regression. :thumbsup:

Natalie: I approve as well. I'll own the canary monitoring and metrics. I'll watch: cost_per_1k, cpu_rss, error_rate.

Deploy Bot: Exemption recorded: requestor=Jonah approvers=[Maya,Natalie] status=APPROVED. Scheduling canary now on request.

sre-oncall: I'll standby in case we need infra-level rollback or pod scaling. Notify #incidents if latencies > 200ms or error_rate > 0.5%.

Jonah: Starting canary now. I'll post short status updates every 5m.

(5m) Jonah: Canary traffic at 5% — cpu_rss dropped to 65% in canary nodes, cost trend down by ~80% for that slice. No errors.

(20m) Natalie: Canary looks good. Proceeding with ramp to 100% over next 8 minutes.

Deploy Bot: Canary completed. Ramp scheduled and executing.

Paul: After ramp, remember to pin infra config and add note in changelog: "Reverted model pin to v2.12 due to embeddings cost regression; follow-up: perf investigation on v2.14."

Jonah: Done — changelog updated and ticket linked. Thanks all. Closing exemption thread once post-rollout metrics stabilize.

Maya: Nice work — please file a follow-up to reproduce on perf harness and add a regression test to prevent future silent cost spikes. :white_check_mark:
